_README: JPL Horizons heliocentric position vectors used as ground truth. Regenerate with `node scripts/fetch-horizons.mjs`. To add entries by hand: Horizons → Ephemeris Type: Vector Table, Center: Sun (500@10), Reference plane: ecliptic, Reference frame: ICRF, Output units: AU-D, Time: TDB, Table: position only. Use system barycentres (3 = Earth–Moon, 4 = Mars, ...). Each entry may set an optional "toleranceAu" (default 0.01).
frame: Heliocentric (500@10), ecliptic and mean equinox of J2000.0, ICRF

entries.toleranceNote: Standish Table 1 Saturn error is up to ~600 arcsec (≈0.03 AU) over 1800–2050.
